data.outcome_summary: This OECD TALIS 2024: Spain note summarizes self-reported teacher and principal questionnaire results for lower secondary education, using OECD’s TALIS 2024 Database tables. The report focuses on descriptive indicators (e.g., teacher age and gender composition, experience, perceived ability to adapt teaching to cultural diversity, special education needs context, social and emotional learning confidence, and technology/AI use) and highlights only statistically significant differences or changes relative to the OECD average. It also reports teacher learning opportunities (initial teacher education preparation, induction/mentoring, professional learning participation, perceived impact, and barriers) and aspects of teacher leadership/autonomy, professional relationships, teaching profession status, employment terms, stress sources, working hours, and professional outcomes. Because the note does not provide an individual-level predictive modeling framework, it should be interpreted as policy-relevant descriptive benchmarking rather than as evidence of causal effects.
